preview: Barclays interview and internship experience featuring an online test, a technical interview, and an HR round, followed by a virtual internship and PPO opportunity.
content: Barclays Interview and Internship Experience 8 November,2019. Barclays had visited the Campus for Internship hiring in November 2019. There was one Technical Round and one HR Round after Selection from the Online Test. Only Computer and IT Branch were allowed for appearing in the Online Test. Round 1: Online Test Online Test was Conducted on HackerEarth Platform. There were two sections: Aptitude(Technical MCQs) and Coding Round. Aptitude(Technical): Major part of this section had questions based on SQL Queries, JAVA Programming and Data Structures. Few Questions were based on Operating System and Networking.Very few quantitative & logic based questions were also there in this section. Coding Section(60 min): There were 2 coding Questions. Questions were different for everyone.Difficulty Level of the questions was easy/moderate. I had one question related to prime numbers array and another question related to lexicographically ordering of Strings. (You can easily crack this round if you have some practice with competitive programming.) Round 2: Technical Interview I was first asked to introduce myself. After this, I was asked technical questions as following:- 1) Object Oriented Programming Concepts with real life examples. 2) One String Based Coding Question using JAVA. 3) Searching & Sorting Algorithms.(Binary Search,Time & Space Complexities of Merge Sort, Quick Sort,Heap Sort etc). 4) Some Questions related to JAVA Programming Concepts . 5) Joins in SQL (Given the tables and asked to write the Inner Join SQL Query) After this I was asked questions based on my Projects (Since I had mentioned one DBMS Project , I was asked to write/draw about all tables used in the Project) . At the end , I was asked if I had any question for the interviewer. This round lasted for around 30-35 minutes. Round 3 : HR Interview This was a quite easy round. I was asked about Barclays Values (RISES) and some real life examples of them. Then I was asked some general questions and about relocation etc. At the end, I was asked if I had any Question for the interviewer. 14 students were selected for the internship. Internship Experience(June 2020 - July 2020) The internship was conducted virtually due to covid crisis.( Otherwise the Office Location is in Kharadi,Pune). Interns had been offered Role as Graduate Intern at BUK . For project,Some interns were grouped in a team of 3 members(Of same college) , some were individual and some worked with their business teams. I was a part of 3 members team and we were assigned an Interesting project- Data Masking and Refresh Utility. We got to work on technologies like AngularJS,Spring Boot,RESTful Web Services,JDBC,SQL Server etc. Other teams projects were also very interesting. You will get to learn and work on new technologies depending on the project requirements. We were also assigned a technical guide for guidance related to the project. Line Managers conduct the meetings (1 or 2 times) for tracking the progress of the project and may give some suggestions in the project. There were also some leadership,training and other interactive sessions from the higher authorities and renowned personalities of the organisation during the internship. After the project completion , all teams had to give a presentation on their respective projects. (Presentation followed by Q&A session). Pre-Placement Offer: Out of 14 students from our campus, 9 people were offered a PPO. Based on the Presentation Performance and after conducting reviews with the line managers, Students were given a Pre-Placement Offer. Thus, Overall it was a very Nice Experience of Internship in Barclays. All The Very Best Guys!!
